trust_decision.summary: The stored rich-text setting disable_booking_message is read from the settings table and echoed unescaped into the public booking_message view; the decision to treat it as sanitized HTML rather than trusted markup is made at write time in Booking_settings::save and at render time in booking_message.php, and every other settings-write route plus the shared setting() setter bypasses both.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says disable_booking_message is rendered as raw HTML on the public booking page, which is exactly this unescaped <?= vars('message_text') ?> echo; Booking.php:139-145 is the only producer of that variable from the setting.

fix_sites.module_kind: controller / JSON save endpoint (sanitizer added at fix.diff:36-41)

fix_sites.entry_point: GET / and GET /booking/reschedule/:hash (Booking::index loads pages/booking_message at application/controllers/Booking.php:155)
fix_sites.module_kind: view template / public render (pure_html added at fix.diff:55)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The REST settings endpoint is a documented admin-only API, and after the render-side pure_html it can no longer inject script into the public page, so a solver can argue it is a separate admin surface outside the advisory's booking-settings page and leave it unsanitized on write.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
disable_booking_message is meant to be rich text: the shipped default is '

Thanks for stopping by!

We are not accepting new appointments...

' and the admin edits it in a trumbowyg HTML editor, so escaping the output (e()) or strip_tags() on save destroys the intended paragraphs and centered layout.

O6_input_shapes: whole payload absent or null (check('booking_settings', 'array|null') at application/controllers/Booking_settings.php:100) -> empty loop
batch array of {name, value} setting objects, several saved per request (Booking_settings.php:102-104)
per-setting value missing or null -> coerced to '' before pure_html (fix.diff:40)
raw HTML string value -> passed through HTMLPurifier (fix.diff:40)
name that is not in the rich-text list (e.g. label_custom_field_*) keeps the pre-existing strip_tags branch (Booking_settings.php:111-116)

O7_producer.where: application/helpers/setting_helper.php:64-66 reads the persisted settings row; Booking.php:139 loads it into message_text and the render-time pure_html at booking_message.php:12 never calls that loader or the Booking_settings save path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PUT /api/v1/settings/disable_booking_message (and any setting name) stores the request 'value' raw through setting([$name => $value])
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The REST API is admin-authenticated (application/libraries/Api.php:65-94) and writes the same settings table; with the view sanitizing on render the API looks like a harmless admin convenience rather than part of the XSS surface.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: controllers/api/v1 package, 2 layers from the landing point (view -> Booking controller -> setting() helper -> settings_model->save), route at application/config/routes.php:198 and documented at docs/rest-api.md:393-395

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /business_settings/save accepts arbitrary {name, value} setting pairs with no setting-name whitelist, so disable_booking_message can be written raw here too
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The business settings page only exposes book_advance_timeout and future_booking_limit (application/views/pages/business_settings.php:105,120), so a solver reads this controller as unrelated to the booking message.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same controllers package, one file away from Booking_settings; allowed_setting_fields at Business_settings.php:23

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The generic setting([...]) setter used by controllers writes any name/value pair straight into the settings table with no sanitization
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A generic config helper cannot know which settings are rich text, and sanitizing every setting there would be an over-broad behavioural change, so it is plausibly argued out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: helpers package; shared by all controllers and by Settings_api_v1::update

O8b_injection_room.sibling: General_settings::save whitelists the three legal rich-text settings (cookie_notice_content, terms_and_conditions_content, privacy_policy_content) and saves them with no pure_html, while Legal_settings::save does sanitize the same names.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The whitelist was copied across controllers and the render-side pure_html already exists in the modal components, so a maintainer adding or moving a rich-text setting here would naturally repeat this exact bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The fix itself introduces a per-name allowlist ($rich_text_settings, fix.diff:25-27); a new rich-text booking setting added to the page but not to that list is stored raw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Name allowlists duplicated inside one controller drift every time a new setting is added, and the neighbouring label_custom_field_ branch shows a second, weaker sanitizer already living in the same loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Legal_settings keeps a parallel $legal_content_settings + pure_html block; another legal rich-text field added later can be left off the list.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix copies this exact per-controller pattern into Booking_settings, so the same shape already exists in the codebase and is the obvious template for the next setting.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: message_title is echoed unescaped in the same template; making the title configurable through a settings field would reproduce the same sink.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same template and same raw vars() echo as the vulnerable line 12, so a small feature addition turns it into the identical bug.

O9_family: CWE-79 improper neutralization of input during web page generation (stored cross-site scripting)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >= 8.2 with ext-curl/json/mbstring/gd/simplexml/fileinfo; Composer (composer.json:30-51) with ezyang/htmlpurifier ^4.19; PHPUnit ^12.4 dev; phpunit.xml bootstraps index.php against a CodeIgniter 3 app tree
O10_build.project_tests: Only tests/Unit/Helper/ArrayHelperTest.php and tests/Unit/Helper/ValidationHelperTest.php exist; there is no test for booking settings, the booking_message view or XSS sanitization, and the published fix adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape the sink with <?= e(vars('message_text')) ?> or strip_tags() the value on save - both destroy the intended centered rich-text default; the other common stop is sanitizing only inside Booking_settings::save and never touching the view or the other settings-write routes.
